review.tagline: Web control center for running coding agents and scheduled automations
review.summary: Agent Canvas is a web frontend that starts conversations with coding agents and switches between multiple Agent Server backends: local, Docker, VM or OpenHands Cloud. It runs the OpenHands agent by default and can use Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Pi, OpenCode or any ACP-compatible agent. A paired Automation Server runs agents on a schedule or on webhook events, with Slack, GitHub and Linear integrations.
review.audience: Developers and teams self-hosting coding agents with scheduled automations
strengths: Works with OpenHands, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Pi, OpenCode or any ACP agent
One UI switches between local, remote and cloud Agent Server backends
Scheduled and webhook-triggered automations with Slack, GitHub and Linear
Option to run each conversation in its own Docker container
weaknesses: Non-Docker install gives the agent full filesystem access on the host
Needs Node.js 24+ and uv for npm or source installs
Automation backend is a separate repo; internet-facing setups need manual hardening
needs: Models: Any LLM (LLM profiles), OpenHands, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI
